title: LibScript Generic Installer & Guest-UI Experiment Specification
description: Declarative contract for cross-OS Bento/Vagrant provisioning, GitHub Release or host-built package resolution, snapshot-isolated headless/quick/custom installation modes, and 100% guest-native desktop and browser authentication verification.

packaging_manifest.description: Relative path from the suite directory to the target stack packaging.json manifest (e.g., ../../_lib/web-apps/openedx/packaging.json).

vagrant.description: Vagrant hypervisor, Bento fork box resolution, and clean vanilla snapshot lifecycle configuration.

bento_prefix.description: Configurable Vagrant box namespace or Bento fork prefix (e.g., bento or custom fork owner).

bento_dir.description: Optional path to a local Bento fork checkout containing built .box artifacts under builds/build_complete.

box_url_template.description: Optional URL template for downloading prebuilt Bento fork boxes directly when not registered locally.

default_target_os.description: Default target guest operating system identifier when --target-os is not supplied.

supported_target_oses.description: Target guest operating systems supported by this installer experiment.

items.description: Target OS slug (e.g., windows-11, debian-13, rockylinux-10.2, freebsd-15.1, macos-14-arm64, alpine-3.24, omnios).

provider.description: Vagrant hypervisor provider used to run guest virtual machines.

vanilla_snapshot_name.description: Snapshot identifier saved on a clean vanilla guest VM and restored prior to each installation mode.

cpus.description: Number of virtual CPUs allocated to the Vagrant guest VM.

memory_mb.description: Guest RAM allocation in MiB for the Vagrant VM.

clean_state_probes.description: Filesystem paths, service names, or TCP ports verified absent after restoring the vanilla snapshot.

items.description: Single clean-state assertion probe evaluated inside the guest OS.

target.description: Guest filesystem path, TCP port number, or service unit name asserted absent.

os_family.description: Guest OS family to which this clean-state probe applies.

artifact.description: Cross-OS target installer artifact format and source resolution policy (GitHub Releases vs host build).

default_format.description: Default target package format or auto to infer from the resolved guest OS.

supported_formats.description: Package formats supported for resolution and guest installation.

default_source.description: Default artifact acquisition strategy (fetch from GitHub Releases or build anew on host).

release_repo.description: GitHub owner/repository slug queried when package source is github-release.

release_tag.description: GitHub Release tag name or latest.

release_asset_patterns.description: Map from package format (msi, exe, deb, rpm, pkg, dmg) to expected release asset filename substring or regex.

additionalProperties.description: Release asset filename pattern for the given package format key.

build_variant.description: Installer bundle mode passed to host-side LibScript packagers when building anew.

install_matrix.description: Snapshot-isolated installation workflow modes evaluated on clean vanilla VMs.

modes.description: Ordered list of installation modes executed individually from clean vanilla VM snapshots.

isolate_each_mode_via_snapshot.description: Whether the guest VM is rolled back to the clean vanilla snapshot prior to every install mode.

capture_wizard_dialogs.description: Whether guest-native screenshots of GUI wizard stages are captured during quick and custom installs.

custom_mode_overrides.description: Non-default directory, port, and feature selections applied during the custom GUI install mode.

install_dir_windows.description: Custom installation root path selected on Windows guests during custom GUI install.

install_dir_posix.description: Custom installation root path selected on POSIX guests during custom install.

enable_features.description: Optional feature identifiers toggled on during custom GUI installation.

disable_features.description: Optional feature identifiers toggled off during custom GUI installation.

custom_env.description: Additional custom key/value parameters supplied to the custom installer flow.

verification.description: 100% guest-native desktop shortcut and multi-endpoint browser authentication screenshot policy.

capture_desktop_icons.description: Policy governing desktop shortcut verification and desktop screenshot capture.

service_ready_timeout_sec.description: Maximum seconds to poll guest HTTP service health endpoints before failing verification.

browser_preference.description: Ordered guest browser executable candidates for CDP DOM login and screenshot verification.

items.description: Browser binary identifier (e.g., chromium, google-chrome, msedge, firefox).

inherit_packaging_verification_screensho.description: Automatically execute all desktop, unauthenticated browser, and authenticated login screenshot steps declared in packaging_manifest.

extra_verification_steps.description: Optional suite-specific verification screenshot steps appended after packaging_manifest steps.

items.description: Additional guest desktop or browser verification step.

service_port.description: Guest localhost TCP port serving the target web application.

url_template.description: Target URL opened inside the guest browser.

healthcheck_path.description: HTTP path polled on service_port prior to opening the browser.
